title: GSE cardinality-conditioned circular slot-transport three-seed training
purpose: Determine whether count-conditioned bijective circular slots recover complete multi-exit geometry safely enough to establish the learned structural-semantic observation method before node generation.

approval.scope: One immutable Gate-3 three-seed slot-transport training: C01-C06 gradients, C07 checkpoint and refusal selection, C08 one zero-adaptation transfer; no C09/C10/M-TARE/graph/planner.
approval.confirmation_reference: User instructed continuous autonomous execution and delegated best-method choices without routine approval prompts.

raw_sources: Sealed C01-C08 deduplicated five-frame causal LiDAR shards.
Sealed FAIL set-process training and failure-attribution evidence used only to motivate the architecture.
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local project-generated procedural worlds and objective targets.

worlds.fit: Exact S01-S10 x C01-C06: 60 worlds and the only gradient source.
worlds.selection: C07 selects each checkpoint and one refusal threshold; C08 is one final zero-adaptation transfer only.
worlds.forbidden: C09, C10 and all M-TARE worlds

sampling.rule: Five causal frames per observation at one-metre arc intervals. Deterministic world shuffle and four-column circular rolls are fixed. Count classes use ordinary cross-entropy; slot assignment is an exact permutation-invariant bijection with no class/loss weights.

teacher.source: Exact circular exit centers, residuals, widths and vertical profiles plus objective local axis and width/height/slope/curvature masks from frozen procedural geometry.
teacher.use: Predicted cardinality activates exactly K sensor-azimuth slots; minimum-cost permutation gives a bijective slot-to-exit loss. Circular slot mass supervises continuous bearing and slot-pooled geometry.
teacher.valid_mask: Residual/profile at exact exits; width has an independent exit mask; global geometry uses its four-value mask.
teacher.student_input: Five causal normalized range/valid frames only.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: No graph is created in this run; any later edge must remain physical-traversal-only.

split.fit: C01-C06 gradients and fixed circular augmentation only.
split.checkpoint_and_threshold_selection: C07 minimum total validation loss selects each checkpoint. The three-seed ensemble selects maximum-recall observation refusal at exit precision at least 0.995 with score equal to count confidence times minimum selected-slot concentration.
split.strict_test: C08 applies frozen checkpoints and the single C07 threshold once. C09/C10/M-TARE remain unread.
split.historical_pollution_audit: All seeds start from scratch; older checkpoints are baseline/failure evidence only and are never loaded.

methods.main: Three from-scratch 787328-parameter cardinality-conditioned circular slot-transport models with fixed K slots, bijective matching, circular resultant bearings and slot-pooled exit geometry.
methods.baseline: Frozen set-process model: count accuracy 0.967/0.960 but safe recall 0.000440/0.000310 and count-3 exact-set at 10 degrees 0.0479/0.0521.
methods.fallback: Any safety, complex-cardinality, geometry or system failure stops before node generation and triggers architecture-level diagnosis only; no oracle count, threshold relaxation, retraining or planner compensation.

acceptance.continuous_exit_set: C07-selected refusal at one-to-one tolerance at most 2 degrees yields exit precision at least 0.995 and recall at least 0.50 on C07 and C08.
acceptance.cardinality: Raw count accuracy at least 0.80, deployed structural-action macro-F1 at least 0.80, and raw and safely accepted exact sets at least 0.50 on both.
acceptance.complex_structure: Count-3 raw exact sets at least 0.40 and safely accepted fraction at least 0.30; count-4 raw at least 0.20 and safely accepted fraction at least 0.10 on both.
acceptance.slot_geometry: Matched bearing MAE at most 1 degree, opening-width MAE at most 3 m and vertical-profile MAE at most 1 m.
acceptance.global_geometry: Axis at most 10 degrees; width/height at most 2 m; slope at most 2 degrees; curvature at most 0.02 per m.
acceptance.system: Exactly 34110 optimizer steps; C08 checkpoint observations zero; C09/C10/M-TARE/graph/planner zero.

failure_policy: Any frozen-input, split, environment or evidence drift is a system failure. Scientific failure is sealed and stops node generation; no retry, seed selection, class weighting, wider matching or planner compensation.
retention: Retain all three checkpoints, histories and summaries; compact development predictions; set/refusal/cardinality/geometry and per-world metrics; figures and source; environment, commands, logs, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal.

estimated_cost.compute: Three sequential CUDA trainings plus frozen C07/C08 evaluation
